CRITICAL THINKING AND MORAL CONVICTION MATTER THROUGHOUT LIFE; UNCRITICAL ACCEPTANCE OF ESTABLISHMENT VIEWS CAN REFLECT IMMATURITY RATHER THAN MATURITY.
SURVEILLANCE POWERS ARE READILY ABUSED EVEN AGAINST THOSE WITH NOTHING TO HIDE; PRIVACY PROTECTION MATTERS INDEPENDENTLY OF WRONGDOING.
MARKETS ARE TOOLS THAT WORK WELL IN SOME DOMAINS BUT NOT OTHERS; COMPLETELY UNREGULATED MARKETS PRODUCE MONOPOLIES, EXTERNALITIES, AND INEQUALITY.

ABSTRACT ART CAN POWERFULLY EXPRESS IDEAS AND EMOTIONS; DISMISSING IT REFLECTS A NARROW VIEW OF WHAT ART CAN ACCOMPLISH.

GOVERNMENT SHOULD HOLD BUSINESSES ACCOUNTABLE FOR MISLEADING THE PUBLIC; THIS PROTECTS CONSUMERS AND MARKET INTEGRITY.

LUCK PLAYS A ROLE IN OUTCOMES, BUT THIS FRAMING CAN EXCUSE FAILURES TO ADDRESS SYSTEMATIC BARRIERS AND INJUSTICE.
